import_rows_billed_check.name: import_rows_billed_check
import_rows_billed_check.value:
("import_rows"."billed_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "import_rows"."billed_amount_minor" > 0)
        AND ("import_rows"."billed_currency" IS NULL OR "import_rows"."billed_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

imports_screen_total_check.name: imports_screen_total_check
imports_screen_total_check.value:
("imports"."screen_total_minor" IS NULL OR "imports"."screen_total_minor" > 0)
        AND ("imports"."screen_total_currency" IS NULL OR "imports"."screen_total_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

imports_confirmed_check.name: imports_confirmed_check
imports_confirmed_check.value: "imports"."status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'undone') OR "imports"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL

expenses_billed_check.name: expenses_billed_check
expenses_billed_check.value:
("expenses"."billed_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "expenses"."billed_currency" IS NULL)
        OR ("expenses"."billed_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."billed_amount_minor" > 0 AND "expenses"."billed_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."billed_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

expenses_rate_check.name: expenses_rate_check
expenses_rate_check.value:
("expenses"."rate" IS NULL AND "expenses"."rate_currency" IS NULL)
        OR ("expenses"."rate" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."rate" > 0 AND "expenses"."rate_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "expenses"."rate_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
